# Lesbury Population in the 2011 Census

## Summary

The town of Lesbury in Northumberland, England underwent a population census in 2011. The available sources provide varying population figures for the town. The analysis of the population figures will provide insights into the demographics of Lesbury and its place within the larger context of Northumberland.

## Key Findings
